charterSource: JBT1.3: declare supported IDE editions/build ranges from JBT0; unsupported editions are not claimed
basis: JBT0 pins official WebStorm (recommended-default mode) as the comparator product; this declaration claims build support for that product's pinned branch only. Comparator capture pins (installed build, bundled plugins, engine identity) stay JBT1H pending-capture slots and are NOT claimed here.

supportedEditions.rangeBasis: the 2026.2 bugfix branch of the pinned build; patch releases within the branch do not change the platform API surface, and every build outside it is unsupported

unsupportedEditionsNotClaimed: WebStorm builds before 262.10968 and every non-2026.2 platform branch
rules: The plugin builds, tests, verifies and packages against the pinned edition only; a green gate on any other edition is not claimed and must not be reported as support.

The declared range lives in exactly two repository places that must agree: this file and extensions/jetbrains/gradle.properties; scripts/jetbrains-gate.mjs fails the gate on drift between them, and the build itself refuses a platformType that is not WS.
Widening the range or adding an edition requires new plugin-verifier evidence for every added edition before the claim exists (JBT1-AC3).
This declaration claims build support only; comparator measurement, real-IDE capture and install/boot evidence belong to the JBT1H harness.

repositoryPins.packagedDescriptor: META-INF/plugin.xml inside the buildPlugin distribution (since-build/until-build patched from gradle.properties at build time)
